scenario: A 'battery saver' app requests overlay and notification-policy access alongside a bundled ad SDK.

supported_findings: The app requests SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW and ACCESS_NOTIFICATION_POLICY in addition to INTERNET.
Strings reference a third-party ad SDK (com.adnetwork.sdk.init) and a banner ad unit ID.
The app connected once to ads-relay.example.com, transferring 4200 bytes, consistent with an ad request/response.
unsupported_claims_to_watch_for: Any claim that this traffic represents malicious C2 communication -- the volume and destination are consistent with routine ad-SDK activity.
Any claim identifying a specific person as having viewed or interacted with the ads.
